title: Image statistics
description: Size and intensity of the entity's image stack, with its average and maximum projections saved as images. Fills the ophys.image_stats columns.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Variable that holds the image stack (height x width x frames).

averageOutput.title: Average projection
averageOutput.description: Variable the average over frames is saved to. Leave empty to not save it.

maximumOutput.title: Maximum projection
maximumOutput.description: Variable the maximum over frames is saved to. Leave empty to not save it.
